integrity: The proof derives every conjugacy class from fixed-point-freeness and checks each of the three adjacency relations. The nonisomorphism witness is the number of invariant one-dimensional subspaces in the characteristic derived subgroup. The included verifier reconstructs the semidirect products and conjugacy-class graphs at two primes.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula assumes an abelian Frobenius kernel and a cyclic complement.
The collision family disproves graph determination for these examples but does not classify all graph-determined finite groups.
The 2009 commuting-graph theorem already proves disconnection for broader Frobenius cases; the new content is the exact graph structure, the nilpotent equality, and action blindness.
The full text of the 2017 nilpotent-conjugacy-class article was not available for complete comparison.
title: Action-blind conjugacy-class graphs of abelian-by-cyclic Frobenius groups
